scripts.title: Xeuk subplace finder lets you copy it and tp
scripts.script:
getgenv().gethui = function() return game.CoreGui.RobloxGui end -- why not?
task.wait(0.5)
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))()
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "Xeuk Subplace Finder", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "SubPlaces"})
local Tab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Main", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998", PremiumOnly = false})
local selected
local Dropdown = Tab:AddDropdown({
    Name = "Select Place",
    Default = nil,
    Options = {},
    Callback = function(Value) 
        selected = Value:match("%(ID: (%d+)%)")
    end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "Teleport to Selected Game",
    Callback = function() 
        if selected then
            game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(tonumber(selected), game.Players.LocalPlayer)
        end
    end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "Copy Selected Game ID",
    Callback = function()
        if selected then
            setclipboard(selected)
            print("Copied Place ID: " .. selected)
        else
            print("No Place ID selected to copy.")
        end
    end
})

local pages = game:GetService("AssetService"):GetGamePlacesAsync()
local places = {}
while task.wait() do
    for _,place in pairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
        table.insert(places, place.Name .. " (ID: " .. tostring(place.PlaceId) .. ")")
    end
    if pages.IsFinished then break end
    pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
end
Dropdown:Refresh(places, true)
OrionLib:Init()
scripts.features: Lets you copy and teleport to subplaces within the game
